messages:
Hani J: DeployBot just rejected the staging push for redwood/worker:staging-latest — says tag points to multiple digests in ECR :confused:
DeployBot: publish blocked — inconsistent tag resolution detected (tag=staging-latest resolved to sha256:aa11... and sha256:bb22... within 2s window). Policy: fail on ambiguous tag resolution. See runbook: /runbooks/tag-ghosting
Vera P: that's the classic tag-ghosting / eventual-consistency symptomatic. We pushed two builds in quick succession from different CI runners, maybe replication overlapped
Sam O: I can confirm; `aws ecr list-images` returned both digests for the tag for a few seconds then flipped. This is in staging, but we should not promote until pinned
PM Zoe: Product wants canary to go out in the next window. Is manual pin reasonable here? What's risk of forcing through?
Hani J: Manual pin to the known-good digest is low risk. Proposal: pin tag `staging-latest` to sha256:aa11... (the build validated by E2E), hold promotion for 20 minutes, re-run DeployBot verify. Operator must annotate comment with `release:manual-pin` and `reason:tag-ghosting`
DeployBot: advisory — manual pin allowed for ambiguous tag events when operator documents `buildid` and `reason`. Manual pins are audited and require a follow-up incident.
Sam O: I'll perform the put-image copy now and include the CI build link. Commands:
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository redwood/worker --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:aa11...
aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/worker --image-manifest file://manifest.json --image-tag staging-latest
```
Infra Bot: scheduled change window note 30m hold for canary promotion while manual pin and verification complete. Notifying release manager.
Vera P: After pin, run `ecr describe-images --image-ids imageTag=staging-latest` across regions to confirm consistent resolution. Also add a short CI guard: throttle concurrent publishes to same tag within 60s
Sam O: pinned and re-verified. DeployBot now reports: provenance verified for staging-latest (sha256:aa11...) :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: publish allowed 1 staging-latest -> sha256:aa11... (manual-pin fallback)
Hani J: Follow-ups: (1) add rate-limit/coalescing to our CI push step to prevent parallel writers to same tag, (2) ops to run a 1h audit of recent tag churn, (3) update runbook with manual-pin checklist and required fields for DeployBot comment
PM Zoe: noted on release notes: "Staging promotion briefly held due to tag ghosting; manual pin applied to ensure consistent canary."
Vera P: I'll open the incident and assign follow-ups. Closing thread when PR and incident ticket linked.
Sam O: dropping put-image logs and DeployBot comment into incident now :white_check_mark:
